description: PARKED 2026-08-01, tracce pattern (thegredc estate). Last real human commit 2026-05-03 (gitignore hygiene); 27 renovate MRs in the prior 90 days serviced a repo nobody was working in.
dependencyDashboardApproval at the TOP level: nothing raises a merge request on its own -- not even patches. Everything queues as checkboxes on the Dependency Dashboard, visible but silent.

This is a PARK, not an abandonment, and deliberately NOT enabled:false. Renovate applies vulnerabilityAlerts last with dashboard approval defaulted off, so a vulnerable dependency still raises an MR immediately -- supply-chain posture stays intact on an unwatched repo.
TO UNPARK when work resumes: delete the dependencyDashboardApproval key and this description. Expect a backlog batch; tick dashboard entries in groups.
